verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a per-result relevance score field in Search responses. The only relevance-related item describes a latency-vs-relevance tradeoff control that shapes `results[].content`, which is an adjacent setting, not a readable score a developer could threshold on. A per-result score is a fair question for a search API, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this "none".

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-result relevance scores to threshold what enters my pipeline
